label: Курс
description: A 10-sentence usage card for курс (course; rate).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Курс' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Этот' and 'полезный' are agreeing masculine forms, and 'очень' intensifies the praise.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Курс' is the accusative after 'на', marking enrolment. 'Новый' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Курса' is the genitive after 'от', here meaning the exchange rate. 'Валют' is a further genitive plural specifier.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Курсе' is the prepositional form after 'о', the topic of discussion. 'Доллара' is the genitive specifier.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of manner. 'Курсом' is the instrumental describing the direction of travel. 'Прежним' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Курсу' is the dative after 'благодаря', marking the cause. 'Я выучил язык' states the result.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Курс' is the accusative direct object of 'закончил'. 'Годовой' agrees in the masculine accusative, and 'преподаватель' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Курсов' is the genitive plural after 'много'. 'Интересных' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'в университете' gives the place.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Курсы' is the nominative plural subject of 'начинаются'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'в сентябре' is the prepositional time phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Курсом' is the instrumental after 'за', the pattern for tracking something. 'Евро' is the indeclinable specifier.
